# Hours Tracker Demo by P-Devs

> Interactive portfolio demo of a calendar-based work-hours tracker.

## Canonical URL

- [Open the demo](https://hours-demo.pauuu.dev/)
- [Visit the P-Devs portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/)

## Demo behavior

- Use the preview password shown inside the app.
- Visitor-created data resets every day at 12:00 AM Asia/Manila.
- The default preview password survives the reset and cannot be changed.
- Do not enter real or sensitive information.
